TEKO Dealership

## Summary
TEKO Dealership helps customers find modern electric vehicles and golf carts for neighborhoods, resorts, campuses, golf, and everyday local travel. The lineup includes TURBOLITE, TURBO, TROPHY, TRIUMPH, and TROPHY PLUS.

## Questions and answers
- What is TEKO EV? TEKO EV is a lineup of purpose-built low-speed electric vehicles and golf carts for local mobility.
- Where can I find a TEKO dealer? Use the dealer page to search the national dealership network by city or state.
- How can I finance a TEKO vehicle? Use the financing page to compare six external lending partners and apply through the lender you choose.

## Vehicle catalog
### TURBOLITE
Price: $9,495
Seats: 2 or 4
Top speed: 25 mph
Range: Call for Details
Description: Compact golf cart available in 2-seat and 2+2 configurations with golf bag mounts, scorecard clip, golf ball holder, 5 kW AC motor, and 51.2V LiFePO4 battery.

### TURBO
Price: $9,995
Seats: 4 (2+2)
Top speed: 19 mph
Range: Up to 40 miles
Description: Flexible 2+2 electric golf cart with front and rear cargo compartments, side console storage, CarPlay, Android Auto, and HD rear-view camera.

### TROPHY
Price: $10,995
Seats: 4 forward-facing
Top speed: 19 mph
Range: Up to 40 miles
Description: Refined four-seat electric vehicle with 5 kW AC motor, lithium battery, premium sound, LED lighting, touchscreen, and HD rear-view camera.

### TRIUMPH
Price: $12,995
Seats: 6 forward-facing
Top speed: 19 mph
Range: Up to 40 miles
Description: Lifted six-seat electric vehicle with 1,300+ lb hauling capacity, 30% grade climbing, independent shocks, all-terrain tires, and premium seating.

### TROPHY PLUS
Price: $12,995
Seats: 6 (4+2)
Top speed: 19 mph
Range: Up to 40 miles
Description: Six-seat utility-focused electric vehicle with adaptive suspension, front and rear cargo storage, fold-down cargo platform, and 1,300+ lb hauling capacity.
